mcp.intro: The endpoint Claude Code, Codex and Mistral Vibe connect to. The token lives in the macOS Keychain and survives app restarts.

status.no_port: the active workspace has no MCP port assigned

mcp.title: MCP server

showtime.description: A .showtime file opens as a presentation preview (the preview Showtime writes into the file on every save). When Showtime is installed, the preview offers “Open in Showtime”: the deck opens in Showtime, and the agent Showtime starts gets a connection to Portuni with this node as its home node and the node's mirror as a second working folder.
showtime.desktop_only: Opening in Showtime is only available in the desktop app.
showtime.label: Showtime

detected.empty: No runner is registered on this device yet.
detected.intro: A runner is a tool (e.g. Claude Code) that the server starts and drives over the canonical event protocol. Sign-in stays with the CLI itself; Portuni never offers its own sign-in.
detected.not_signed_in: Installed but not signed in; sign in directly in the {{runner}} CLI.
detected.title: Runners

env_keys.portuni_key: “{{key}}”: PORTUNI_* variables cannot be set from the instance registry.
env_keys.secret_shaped: “{{key}}” looks like a secret (*_TOKEN/*_KEY/*_SECRET/*PASSWORD*); store it in the OS keychain, not here.

instances.intro: An instance describes what goes into the environment of a started task, typically CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=… to switch accounts. For security reasons, values are never read back from the registry.
instances.title: Instances

org_defaults.intro: When a task is created from a node, the instance set for its organization is offered as the default.
org_defaults.title: Default instance per organization

row.delete_confirm_message: The instance is deleted from the registry and is no longer offered when creating a task. Organization defaults that pointed to it are cleared.
row.env_values_hint: For security reasons, values are never read back. An empty value on an existing key stays unchanged; enter it again only if you want to overwrite it.

update.desktop_only: Updates are only available in the desktop app.
update.title: Updates

users.description: Accounts with access to this Portuni server. Invited users have never signed in yet – you can share with and assign a placeholder account right away.
users.title: Users

create.created_hint: Workspace created. Enter the Turso token after you switch to the workspace, in Settings.
create.id_hint: ID: <mono>{{id}}</mono> – cannot be changed after creation.
create.id_hint_invalid: ID: <mono>(invalid)</mono> – cannot be changed after creation.
create.title: Add workspace
create.turso_url_hint: If you leave it empty, the workspace starts with a local SQLite database – the token is entered after you switch to the workspace, in Settings.

list.delete_warning: The workspace is removed from the app, its sidecar stops and its tokens are deleted from the Keychain. Data on disk (mirror folders and databases) stays – delete it by hand if you don't want it.
list.intro: Each workspace has its own sidecar, port and data (a personal workspace has its own Turso database, a team workspace a central server). The health of a workspace without an open window can only be seen here – backend status events only reach that workspace's own window.
list.title: Workspaces
